name: Bubble Level
description: A spirit level that uses your phone's sensors, with degrees, calibration and a buzz when it's level.
prompt: A bubble level app with a green vial and a bubble that moves with the phone's tilt sensors, X and Y degrees, calibration, hold reading and a vibration when it is perfectly level.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Un nivel de burbuja que usa los sensores del móvil, con grados, calibración y una vibración cuando está nivelado.
